deterministic_baseline_result.caveat: This is an infrastructure/baseline result for a hand-written heuristic rule set, NOT an LLM-accuracy claim. It must never be reported or compared as if it were a language model's performance -- see Phase 2A-2 spec section 33.

notes: This manifest freezes the 62 questions, their expected_status values, and their gold_plan values exactly as they existed at the end of Phase 2A.

During Phase 2A-2 (real LLM evaluation), the 62 questions/statuses/gold plans in benchmark_cases.json MUST NOT be edited. If a genuine authoring error in v0.1 is discovered during LLM evaluation, it must be recorded and reported separately (never silently patched in v0.1) -- a correction becomes v0.1.1 or v0.2 AFTER this evaluation completes, per the Phase 2A-2 spec section 1.

The few-shot development set (src/qch/nl/fewshot_examples_v0.1.json) is a SEPARATE, also-frozen file: 8 hand-authored examples covering metric_lookup, filtering, transition_delta, compositional_sort_limit, ambiguity, unknown_metric, relation_traversal, and version_comparison concepts, using version labels (V10, V11) and phrasing that do not appear in the 62 benchmark questions.
